how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for NHM Jharkhand Specialist Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal. The extended last date is 15 November 2026.
Visit the official recruitment portal at recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in.
Find the relevant Specialist Medical Officer recruitment advertisement.
Read the notification and extension notice carefully.
Check the required educational qualifications, age limit, and other eligibility conditions.
Complete the online application form with the required personal, educational, and professional details.
Select the preferred facilities, subject to the maximum permitted number.
Enter the proposed monthly remuneration for each selected facility.
Upload the necessary photograph, signature, certificates, and other required documents.
Pay the application fee if prescribed by the recruitment portal.
Review the application and submit it before 15 November 2026.
Ensure that the application status shows "Submitted Successfully".
Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online recruitment portal. Applications submitted through post, email, hand delivery, or other modes will not be considered. Candidates should avoid submitting duplicate applications for the same post.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 106 Specialist Medical Officer vacancies under NHM programmes cover specializations including Anesthesia, Dermatology, ENT, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, General Medicine, Psychiatry, Radiology, and Surgery. The 200 Non-Teaching Specialist Medical Officer vacancies cover several medical specializations, including Anesthesia, ENT, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, Psychiatry, Radiology, Surgery, Forensic Medicine, Pathology, Paediatrics, General Medicine, Dermatology, and Cardiology, as listed in the facility-wise vacancy annexure. Candidates must refer to Annexure-I of the relevant notification for the complete district-wise, hospital-wise, and specialization-wise vacancy distribution. content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with the requisite Postgraduate Degree or Diploma in the relevant medical specialty from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Medical Registration: Candidates must possess valid registration with the appropriate Medical Council. Specialization: Applicants must hold the required postgraduate qualification in the specialty for which they are applying. Eligibility Date: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed eligibility requirements as specified in the respective notification.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their age as on 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Salary and Remuneration
content_sections.text: Specialist Medical Officers will be engaged through a financial bidding process. Candidates must quote their expected monthly remuneration for each selected facility. Important: Rs. 3,00,000 is the maximum permitted monthly bid amount and should not be treated as a fixed or guaranteed salary. Candidates must quote their proposed remuneration separately for each selected facility. The quoted bid will be considered during the selection process.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of Specialist Medical Officers will be conducted through a facility-wise financial bidding process, subject to the prescribed eligibility requirements. Applications will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria. Candidates may select a maximum of three facilities in one application. For each facility, the eligible candidate quoting the lowest acceptable monthly remuneration will be considered the L-1 bidder. If two or more candidates quote the same amount, preference will be determined according to the prescribed tie-breaking criteria, including postgraduate qualification, relevant experience, and date of birth. Preference and negotiation provisions for applicable reserved categories and Persons with Disabilities will be considered according to the recruitment rules. If the selected L-1 bidder does not join, the department may consider the next eligible bidder according to the prescribed procedure. The department reserves the right to reject bids that are considered unacceptable.

content_sections.heading: Nature and Tenure of Engagement
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for contractual engagement of Specialist Medical Officers. The engagement is contractual and does not constitute regular government employment. The agreement may initially be executed for three years, subject to the conditions stated in the notification. Continuation and renewal will be governed by the prescribed terms, including provisions relating to regular specialist postings. Selected candidates will not acquire a claim to regular appointment, absorption, seniority, or regular government service benefits. The allotted facility will be non-transferable. Selected candidates must comply with the prescribed duties and service conditions.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready while completing the online application. Recent passport-size photograph Candidate's signature 10th marksheet and certificate 12th marksheet and certificate MBBS and relevant postgraduate qualification documents Experience certificates or supporting employment documents, wherever applicable Caste certificate, if applicable PwBD certificate, if applicable Medical Council Registration Certificate Other documents required by the online application portal

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for NHM Jharkhand Specialist Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal. The extended last date is 15 November 2026. Important: Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online recruitment portal. Applications submitted through post, email, hand delivery, or other modes will not be considered. Candidates should avoid submitting duplicate applications for the same post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications under both Specialist Medical Officer recruitment advertisements has been extended to 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 306 vacancies have been announced under two separate advertisements, including 106 Specialist Medical Officer posts and 200 Non-Teaching Specialist Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the Eligibility to apply for Jharkhand NHM Specialist Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: MBBS degree with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty from an NMC-recognized institution, along with valid Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHM Jharkhand Specialist Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 23 years, and the maximum age is 64 years. Age will be calculated as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Has the application deadline been extended for both recruitment advertisements?
faq.answer: Yes. The application deadline has been extended to 15 November 2026 for both Advertisement Nos. NHM/03/2026 (SMO BID)-2750(MD) and HMEW/2026 (SMO Bid)-2755(MD).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Jharkhand NHM Specialist Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: There is no fixed salary. Candidates quote their own monthly remuneration for each facility through bidding, up to a maximum of Rs. 3,00,000 per month, plus an incentive on health insurance claims settled.

faq.question: Q7. How many facilities can a candidate apply for in Jharkhand NHM Specialist Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: A candidate can submit bids for a maximum of three facilities in one application form, quoting the monthly remuneration separately for each facility.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Jharkhand NHM Specialist Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a facility-wise bidding process. For each facility, the eligible bidder quoting the lowest acceptable monthly remuneration (L-1) is considered first, with tie-break rules based on PG Degree over Diploma, experience and date of birth.
